mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiries ( user_id, type, title, content, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, type, title, content, status, answer, answered_at AS answeredAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM inquiries WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, type, title, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM inquiries WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, type, title, content, status, answer, created_at AS createdAt, answered_at AS answeredAt FROM inquiries WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiries SET answer = #{answer}, answered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = 'RESOLVED' WHERE id = #{id}
